verdict.rationale: Reflect documents a public API with OAuth 2 and PKCE support, but its stated scope is narrow: appending data to notes, listing bookmarked links, and "a few other things." Deep-link URLs and Zapier extend automation somewhat, but neither is a full programmatic surface, and no OpenAPI spec could be found. Missing for 10: broad API coverage (reading, searching, creating and editing notes), a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404), detailed endpoint reference docs, and independent hands-on corroboration.
